summary: T1-only supervised document generation/editing with real Provider/Tool budget gates, Web controlled canary, durable F18 revocation and CAS/create-only writes. Reuses existing stores, dispatch and authorization; no second planner or production expansion. Exact PR base..head path partition and independently verified release gate evidence.

g1.necessity: Unmetered Provider/Tool dispatch, missing real usage and repeated writes can cause unbounded physical effects. The model cannot enforce hard budgets or idempotency; existing deterministic CAS and dispatch hooks must reject before sending.

g2.authority_owner: Existing TaskBudgetStore, LLMClient, Engine and ToolExecutionJournal
g2.non_duplication: No second task planner, state store, budget ledger or publish system. Reservations and settlement stay on the existing atomic store and physical dispatch boundaries.

g3.recovery_or_reason: On missing Provider usage, UNKNOWN settlement, stop, budget exhaustion or CAS conflict, fail closed and retain durable evidence. Model can propose revised text only after operator reauthorization, never override the budget gate.

g4.rollback: Revert the isolated T1 budget integration, preserving previous durable stop records and ordinary runtime behavior; no production deployment has happened.
